question: What mental condition brings liberation to a person in this very life?
premises: A person may possess the transcendent mind
The transcendent mind surpasses ordinary mind
Liberation is attributed to such a person here
inference: One whose mind has become transcendent attains liberation here.
uncertainties: bhavantīha may reflect nonstandard agreement or sandhi fusion
plain_english: For one whose mind has become the transcendent mind, there is liberation here.
